properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the Ethereum account/signature curve. The secp256k1, tiny-secp256k1 and @types/secp256k1 packages are declared throughout the root and hardhat-network lockfiles because the web3/ganache/truffle toolchain this library is tested against signs every transaction with ECDSA-secp256k1. All 34 sites are lockfile dependency entries of that stack. The curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol: observable here, replaceable only by the chain, not by this repo.
